name: Da Vittorio
dinnerNote: Senza Confini menu, 12 courses (8-course menus from €280)
dinnerNoteIt: Menu Senza Confini, 12 portate (menu di 8 portate da €280)

menus.name: Senza Confini tasting menu
menus.note: The chefs' free choice; lunch or dinner (no lunch on Wednesdays); shared by the whole table; includes the Paccheri alla Vittorio; wine not included

menus.name: Il Mare di 'Da Vittorio' tasting menu
menus.note: Fish and shellfish from the day's market; lunch or dinner; for the whole table

menus.name: Gli Esordi di Papà Vittorio tasting menu
menus.note: Dishes from the family's early days; lunch or dinner; for the whole table

menus.name: Dalla 'Campagna' tasting menu
menus.note: Vegetables from the estate garden; lunch or dinner; for the whole table

hotel: the Cerea family's own La Dimora, part of the Da Vittorio Relais & Châteaux estate
bookingOpens: By phone, or with the request form on the restaurant's website, which the restaurant answers by email or phone. It is closed on Wednesday lunchtime and for about 20 days in August.
groups: Parties of eight or more are asked to choose their menu in advance. The signature 'Orecchia d'elefante' (veal cutlet) is made only to order, for at least four people.
